meta.title: BetaFPV Web Sim — FPV Simulator in Your Browser
meta.description: Browser-based FPV drone simulator controlled with a physical BetaFPV LiteRadio 2 SE radio via WebHID API. Three.js, realistic racer physics, 3 difficulty levels.

start.title: 🚁 BetaFPV Web Sim
start.welcome: Welcome! Before you start flying, we need to map your radio and calibrate the stick ranges.
start.warning: Note: mapping must be done every time after refreshing the page. Your radio generates signals on different byte pairs each time it connects — that's why mapping cannot be saved permanently. Calibration is remembered in the browser — as long as the radio stays connected.
start.process_1: Mapping: move the sticks, the program shows which byte pairs move, you assign them to drone functions.
start.process_2: Calibration: the program asks you to move each function — it automatically measures min/max.
start.shortcuts: 🎮 In-flight shortcuts: P — pause, Space — OSD crosshair, K — camera angle.

connect.instruction: Click below and select BETAFPV Joystick from the list.

mapping.instruction: Move the sticks one by one (each in every direction) and observe which bars move. Then assign the appropriate pairs to drone functions.
mapping.hint:
⚠️ Tip: if a pair doesn't move with the sticks but moves with a switch — leave it as ---. Unassigned pairs are ignored by the simulator.
📷 CAMERA — assign to a 3-position switch (SA/SB/SC) to change the FPV camera angle.

calib.instruction: The program will ask you to move each function in turn. Move the stick to the limit in both directions. Calibration starts with the right stick (Pitch, Roll), then the left (Throttle, Yaw).
calib.throttle: Move the LEFT stick UP and DOWN — several times to the limit
calib.yaw: Move the LEFT stick LEFT and RIGHT — several times to the limit
calib.pitch: Move the RIGHT stick UP and DOWN — several times to the limit
calib.roll: Move the RIGHT stick LEFT and RIGHT — several times to the limit
calib.range_too_small:
❌ Range too small ({range} < {min}).
Did you really move {fn}?
Try again — move the stick to the limit in both directions.

world.beginner_desc: Learn the basics. Few obstacles, low gravity, slow flight. Perfect for start.
world.intermediate_desc: Training. More trees and gates, higher agility and speed.
world.expert_desc: Realistic racer physics: tilt → horizontal force, angular inertia, 9.81 gravity.

disconnect.title: ⚠️ Radio disconnected
disconnect.hint: Connect the radio back and click below.
